query:
SELECT
                pk_systems.uuid,
                pk_systems.id AS "id: PluralKitId<SystemMarker>",
                pk_systems.name,
                pk_systems.avatar,
                pk_systems.created_at,
                pk_systems.updated_at
            FROM
                pk_systems
            WHERE
                pk_systems.updated_at <= NOW() - interval '24 hours'
            AND
                uuid IN (SELECT uuid FROM pk_tracked_systems)
            ORDER BY
                updated_at
            ASC
            LIMIT 5
